title: Members of the school band
summary: He lists the players: Big Boy Myles, Nolan Blackwell, Alfred Bernard, David Lastie, Warren Miles, Alfred Woodard, Bannister, Edgar Miles and drummer Eric Warner.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in the band? Big Boy Miles or anything?
Yeah, he was in it and his brother.
Well, we all just played different instruments, fooling around more or less. But I can't remember all the guys that was in the band at the time. See, there was Nolan Blackwell. Nolan Blackwell.
He played alto saxophone. And Alfred Bernard, he played tenor saxophone. That was David Leste. He played tenor saxophone.

That was good. Warren Miles, he played piano. I played piano myself too. Alfred Woodard, he played trumpet. And was there in Banister, he played guitar. And Edgar Miles, he played trombone. Well, we made different changes from time to time.
You don't remember who played drums?
